=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:lines 128-145 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: If `read1()` raises `socket.timeout` while draining, the exception handler skips `self.connection.settimeout(1)`, so `_reject(400)` may write using the near-expired drain timeout.
  WHY: The rejection response may time out before the client receives the promised 400; severity differs across reviewers, with Google rating it MAJOR and the others rating it NIT.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:line 143 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `self.connection.settimeout(1)` is outside the `try/except OSError` block, so it can raise uncaught if the connection closes during body draining.
  WHY: The exception can bypass `return self._reject(400)`, preventing the intended rejection response.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:lines 145-147 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Forwarded-header validation rejects invalid headers after the body-drain block rather than routing them through that block.
  WHY: A client uploading a body with an invalid forwarded header may receive a connection reset or BrokenPipeError instead of the intended HTTP 400.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
